a: You can't use Option/Digimon card effects to gain memory, but you can still lose memory if a card effect specifies as such.
Card Q&A.q: My opponent has this card in play when I activate the effect on a card like [BT1-090 Gravity Crush], [BT1-021 MetalGreymon], [BT1-040 WereGarurumon], [BT1-058 Chirinmon], or [BT1-075 Digitamamon]. What happens?

a: No, you don't gain any memory from it.
Card Q&A.q: My opponent has this card in play. Do I gain memory from [ST2-13 Hammer Spark]'s [Security] effect?

Effect: [All Turns] Your opponent can't gain memory except with Tamer effects.
